# music-tempo 1.0.3

`music-tempo.min.js` is the unmodified browser distribution from
https://registry.npmjs.org/music-tempo/-/music-tempo-1.0.3.tgz.
Upstream: https://github.com/killercrush/music-tempo (Beatroot, MIT).
The upstream license is retained in `music-tempo.LICENSE`.

SHA-256: `2927859a8e81e8874a95dc7af3a2a06fedd306826f774b7378e26ad5fa9cbd76`.

The transcription tool executes this local bundle with mini-racer's embedded
V8. Audio is decoded to mono float32 PCM at 44100 Hz, matching the library's
default hop size (441 samples) and time step (0.01 seconds).
